name: Schaffhausen
flagName: Flag of the Canton of Schaffhausen
summary: A yellow square with a black ram leaping toward the hoist, crowned and with golden horns and hooves. The ram ('Schaf') is a pun on the name.
origin: The ram appears on the city seal from the 13th century. Schaffhausen joined the Confederacy in 1501.

symbols.name: Ram
symbols.description: A black ram with a gold crown, horns and hooves.

facts: The Rhine Falls, Europe's largest waterfall by volume, are in Schaffhausen.
Most of the canton lies north of the Rhine.
clues: A black ram leaping on yellow.
Its animal is a pun on its name.
Home to Europe's largest waterfall by volume.
